spans.s:
Khādyaṭapākika (IE 8-3), probably^1 a mistake for Khādyakūṭa-pākika (cf. anna-kūṭa, ‘a heap of food’); same as Mahānas-ādhyakṣa; called Sandhivigrahika, Kumārāmātya, Mahā-daṇḍanāyaka, etc., additionally. See Bhānasa-věrgaḍě, Mahānas-ādhyakṣa, Sūpakārapati, Mahānasika.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
